title: Towards Responsible Evaluation for Text-to-Speech
findings: The paper does not analyze religion, faith, or religious bias. Its discussion of bias focuses on general societal inequities, with specific examples related to accent and gender stereotyping in speech synthesis.

measurement_description: The paper proposes a framework for responsible evaluation of Text-to-Speech (TTS) systems, not a specific benchmark. It does not measure any aspects of faith or religion.
